scenes.headline: Owl at night: generated
scenes.body: Google's Veo 3 demo. No filmmaker, no place, no owl.

scenes.headline: How we checked
scenes.body: Every clip we use has a named creator, a place and a licence. No credit, no post.

caption:
Two of these are real animals. One is a render.

Meta asks people to label photorealistic AI video and audio, and labels content when it detects industry-standard AI signals.

Source: Meta newsroom (2024). Real clips: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen); AI clip: Google DeepMind Veo 3 demo (public domain).
notes: AVOID format: anti-pattern explainer as a quiz. Each clip is labelled immediately (no 'guess in the comments'), and the AI clip is only ever shown labelled as AI.
